subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread opt-in be a separate `dmThreadMode` account setting, part of the existing `replyToMode`/thread-session direction, or paused behind broader Google Chat thread work?
rationale: This PR creates a new public config surface next to existing reply-threading controls and reopens behavior that a merged fix intentionally suppressed, so automation cannot choose the long-term product API safely.

options.title: Choose One Threading Config Surface
options.body: Before merge, decide the canonical Google Chat threading API and update this branch to match that choice with complete type, metadata, docs, and proof.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` Separately
options.body: Maintainers can accept a separate DM-only knob, but the branch still needs the exported type, generated config metadata/baseline, docs/help, and live proof.

options.title: Pause For Broader Thread Work
options.body: Pause or close this PR if the broader Google Chat thread-session work should own DM threading and session behavior together.

recommendation.title: Choose One Threading Config Surface
recommendation.body: Before merge, decide the canonical Google Chat threading API and update this branch to match that choice with complete type, metadata, docs, and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent verification and area-history signal for the Google Chat threading/config boundary under review.
